info.title: Ashr++ A3 Commercial Product Console API
info.summary: Machine-readable A3 hosted security contract for tenant-sensitive product-console reads and commercial workflows.
info.description: A3 owns hosted product enforcement and product workflow surfaces. Protected operations consume a server-verified A1 browser-session or service-account principal with a complete five-level tenant scope. This artifact is a contract, not proof that A1 hosted login or every A3 route is production-complete. A2 remains the sole judge, scoring, policy, and release-decision authority.

x-service-boundary.owner: Hosted Product Enforcement / Product Console / Review Workflow / Report Center / Commercial UI
consumes: A2 immutable evidence and release-decision facts
does_not_own: A1 login, session issuance, or principal verification
A2 release policy or decision semantics

x-required-commercial-notes.tenant: Every protected hosted operation binds organization_id, tenant_id, workspace_id, project_id, and environment_id from a server-verified A1 principal. Client scope values are selectors only and never authority.
x-required-commercial-notes.auth: A3 hosted enforcement accepts only an A1-verified browser-session or service-account principal. This does not claim that A1 hosted login is production-complete.
x-required-commercial-notes.rbac: Every protected operation declares one permission. A3 evaluates it server-side and never trusts a client-declared role.
x-required-commercial-notes.usage: Usage meters are read-only in A3 and must come from A1 usage ledger events before billing claims become live.
x-required-commercial-notes.audit: Mutating, sensitive-read, and share-capability actions emit metadata-only audit events with ids, refs, hashes, statuses, and counts.
x-required-commercial-notes.a2: A3 displays A2 evidence and decisions without recomputing scores, pass/fail, policy, or release decisions.

x-secret-policy.placeholder_policy: Use ids, hashes, aliases, and [REDACTED] only.

x-a1-a2-references.a3_integration_rule: A3 may package and display A1/A2 evidence but must not reinterpret A2 judge semantics or mutate A1 runner/auth/storage behavior.

A1VerifiedSession.name: __Host-ashr_session
A1VerifiedSession.description: A1 browser session accepted only after trusted same-origin server middleware verifies it and supplies an immutable principal to A3. The cookie remains HttpOnly. This hosted enforcement requirement is not a claim that A1 hosted login is production-complete.

A1ServiceAccount.description: Service-account credential verified server-side by A1 before A3 receives an immutable service principal. Raw credentials are never included in this contract or exposed to A3 clients.

ShareToken.name: shareToken
ShareToken.description: Opaque share capability. Servers must redact it from logs, traces, analytics, and error payloads.

ApiKeyId.name: api_key_id
ApiKeyId.description: A1 API-key handle; never raw key material.

NotFound.description: Sanitized not-found response. Cross-tenant reads must not reveal private evidence.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is required or the presented A1 credential could not be verified. The response reveals no tenant, resource, role, or credential detail.

Forbidden.description: The verified principal is not authorized for this operation or complete scope. The response reveals no tenant membership, resource existence, role binding, or required permission detail.

BadRequest.description: The authenticated and authorized request body is not valid JSON. The response and audit record never echo the request body or private identity data.

Cache-Control.description: Prevents caching of request validation failures.

RequestTimeout.description: The authenticated and authorized request body was not received within the configured deadline. The response and audit record never echo the request body or private identity data.

Cache-Control.description: Prevents caching of request validation failures.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The authenticated and authorized request body exceeds the configured byte limit. The response and audit record never echo the request body or private identity data.

Cache-Control.description: Prevents caching of request validation failures.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: The authenticated and authorized mutation requires application/json. The response and audit record never echo the request body or private identity data.

Cache-Control.description: Prevents caching of request validation failures.

UnprocessableEntity.description: The JSON body is valid JSON but is not a top-level object. The response and audit record never echo the request body or private identity data.

Cache-Control.description: Prevents caching of request validation failures.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Authorization configuration or metadata-only access-audit persistence is unavailable. No protected handler is executed.

baseline.description: Display summary copied from the baseline A1, A2, delivery, deployment, and artifact evidence.

candidate.description: Display summary copied from the candidate A1, A2, delivery, deployment, and artifact evidence.

release_ready.description: Server-validated A2 authority result. Clients must not recompute it from scores or cards.

evidence_snapshot.description: Public-safe identifiers, hashes, and completeness only; no raw evidence.

items.description: Metadata only. Secret key material must never be returned.

ledger_summary.description: Currency totals, usage units, provider event counts, ledger event counts, refs, hashes, and statuses only.

message.const: The authorization service is temporarily unavailable.

ReleaseComparisonRuntimeAuthority.description: Current backend A2 Trusted Spine validation attached to a sealed historical comparison. A3 never recomputes A2 authority.

production_ready.description: Always fail-closed until all upstream and deployed environment receipts are authoritative.

evidence_ref.description: Opaque metadata reference only; URLs and local absolute paths are forbidden.

DeploymentReceipt.description: Sanitized receipt metadata. Submission or acknowledgement never counts as production verification; only a hash-valid server readback can populate authority_validation.

DeploymentReceiptAuthoritativeReadback.description: Immutable, hash-chained readback produced by a server-only trusted verifier resolver.

DeploymentAcceptanceProjection.description: Read-only projection of hash-valid readbacks onto the source acceptance. A new sealed acceptance artifact is still required.

DeploymentReceiptVerificationRequest.description: Trigger only. Verification status, claims, evidence, authority, and attestation are supplied by the configured server resolver, never by this request.

SelfHostSandboxCalibration.description: Tenant-scoped local A1 behavior evidence. It never changes production acceptance or A2 authority.

PostgresRlsQualification.description: Live PostgreSQL RLS behavior receipt. Local/staging evidence is not customer-VPC production proof.

A2MultimodalComparisonEnvelope.description: Validated by the A3 two-way v1/v3 and three-way v2 adapters; raw provider payloads and release authority are forbidden.

imported_at.description: Ignored. The server assigns imported_at from its own clock.

idempotency_key.description: Ignored. Use the required Idempotency-Key header.

idempotencyKey.description: Ignored. Use the required Idempotency-Key header.

MultimodalComparisonImportRequest.description: Idempotency is header-only and imported_at is assigned by the server clock.

target_reviewer_hash.description: Hash alias only; raw reviewer identity is forbidden. Required for transfer.

MultimodalReviewAssignmentRequest.description: Identity and scope are server verified. The body cannot contain a disposition, score, risk, or release authority.

MultimodalReviewEvidenceReference.description: Hash-only reference. Raw evidence, URLs, signed URLs, local paths, and free text are forbidden.

due_at.description: Must be in the future and no more than 30 days from server time.

MultimodalReviewEvidenceRequestCreate.description: Scope and identity are server verified. Idempotency is accepted only from the Idempotency-Key header.

MultimodalReviewEvidenceSubmission.description: Scope and identity are server verified. Idempotency is accepted only from the Idempotency-Key header.

MultimodalReviewEvidenceReview.description: Scope and identity are server verified. Idempotency is accepted only from the Idempotency-Key header.

receipts.description: A3 currently accepts an empty array only and fails closed until the exact authoritative receipt schema is published.

note.description: Public-safe note; URLs, credentials, identity, and raw evidence are forbidden.

A2MultimodalRepeatStabilityEnvelope.description: Atomic A2 comparison, review-conservation, and candidate-binding envelope. Repeat stability is not a release decision.

imported_at.description: Ignored. The server assigns imported_at from its own clock.

idempotency_key.description: Ignored. Use the required Idempotency-Key header.

idempotencyKey.description: Ignored. Use the required Idempotency-Key header.

MultimodalRepeatStabilityImportRequest.description: Header-only idempotency; identity and five-level scope are verified server-side.

MultimodalRepeatStability.description: Aggregate stability evidence. Stable blocked repeats remain blocked and never become release authority.

A2MultimodalProviderReadinessEnvelope.description: Atomic public-safe A2 availability and phase-latency evidence. Installation and warm latency do not prove health, quality, or release readiness.

imported_at.description: Ignored. The server assigns imported_at from its own clock.

idempotency_key.description: Ignored. Use the required Idempotency-Key header.

idempotencyKey.description: Ignored. Use the required Idempotency-Key header.

MultimodalProviderReadinessImportRequest.description: Header-only idempotency; availability and latency evidence are accepted atomically under a server-verified five-level tenant scope.

MultimodalProviderReadiness.description: Tenant-scoped A3 projection. Faster warm latency or installed models never imply operational health, qualified quality, or production readiness.

MultimodalReleaseReadiness.description: Read-only A3 projection of the public-safe A2 Round 52 controls/runtime summary and the latest non-client-callable A1 identity boundary. Stability never overrides blocked quality.

x-hosted-security-contract.enforcement_owner: A3 hosted API or same-origin BFF
x-hosted-security-contract.principal_authority: A1 server-side identity and tenancy verifier

public_routes.health: GET /api/a3/health exposes operational status only and no tenant data.
public_routes.share_token: GET /r/{shareToken} is an opaque, expiring, revocable capability route; it is not session-authenticated public console access.
